FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Cellular Connect Solutions, we operate as a retail establishment focused on offering a comprehensive range of cellular phones and accessories. Our operations include selling both new and certified pre-owned devices sourced directly from authorized manufacturers, ensuring that our products meet quality standards and reduce risks associated with counterfeit goods. We provide various cellular services such as repairs, screen replacements, and technical support, all backed by clear and written warranty policies to minimize disputes with customers. Additionally, we maintain strict inventory management systems and conduct regular audits to prevent issues related to theft and loss, while also upholding compliance with data protection regulations to safeguard customer information. Our commitment to quality and security allows us to provide a reliable shopping experience for our customers.

Our business provides cellular phone sales and service, including managing customer data and ongoing support, which may involve addressing and resolving any data breach incidents that arise.
